title: ewas-crossarray-harmonise: reproducible cross-array harmonisation and region detection for longitudinal EWAS
description: Nextflow and Galaxy pipeline that harmonises Illumina HumanMethylation450 and MethylationEPIC data for longitudinal epigenome-wide association studies, and replaces the fixed-gap clustering, fixed-span smoothing and free permutation of the minfi region- and block-finding workflow with a repeated-measures design-aware alternative. Includes a controlled legacy baseline run on the identical harmonised matrix.
